## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL — Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; mixed signals from sectors and stocks provide two confirmations (sector split: Healthcare/Energy/Staples positive vs Technology/Communication weak; Top-5 leadership concentrated). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Healthcare). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Healthcare leads: MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +9.96%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +18.07%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing strength: XOM (1W: +1.59% | 1M: +4.23%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +4.64%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples constructive with names showing short-term lift including WMT (1W: +4.56% | 1M: -7.79%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Technology is weakest: MSFT (1W: -10.59% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +5.00%) CORRECTION. Communication services soft: GOOGL (1W: -3.41% | 1M: -8.66%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -5.09%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary pressure seen in AMZN (1W: -6.14% | 1M: -9.57%) BELOW TREND and SHOP (1W: -10.75% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +7.40% | 1M: +15.33%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +7.13% | 1M: +11.13%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +9.96%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Healthcare) — concentration risk to monitor.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: SHOP (1W: -10.75% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -11.27% | 1M: -3.20%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -11.37% | 1M: +35.52%) CORRECTION, IBM (1W: -12.36% | 1M: +22.30%) CORRECTION, CRM (1W: -12.91% | 1M: -2.03%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W movers: MDT (1W: +9.07%), AMAT (1W: +7.42%), ASML (1W: +7.40%), CVS (1W: +7.13%), UNH (1W: +7.03%) — all ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: multiple large-cap Techs show 1W vs 1M mismatch (PANW, IBM, ORCL, NOW) which signals tactical uncertainty and to watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed and tilted toward CORRECTION for several names: AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND and ASML (1W: +7.40% | 1M: +15.33%) ABOVE TREND contrast with MSFT (1W: -10.59% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND and AAPL (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +5.00%) CORRECTION. Sector is bifurcated between AI/semicap strength and broad software/IT weakness.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials are constructive but mixed: JPM (1W: +4.90% | 1M: +1.58%) ABOVE TREND and PNC (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +3.58%) ABOVE TREND lead while V (1W: -0.96% | 1M: -0.29%) BELOW TREND and MA (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -3.05%) BELOW TREND show patchy internals. Overall Financials are a potential source of stability in this neutral regime.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare is the clearest leader: MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +9.96%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +18.07%) ABOVE TREND — sector breadth supportive and news flow is mostly confirming.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor exposure to Healthcare and select Energy names showing strength (MDT, UNH, LLY, XOM, CVX) and reduce exposure to large-cap Tech names displaying consistent weakness (MSFT, NVDA, ACN). Given NEUTRAL regime and narrow leadership, remain selective and monitor momentum divergence for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +18.07%) ABOVE TREND — follow earnings/news follow-through. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -10.59% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -10.75% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND — watch for further distribution.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +3.86%) — leadership to confirm, Energy (1W: +1.94% | 1M: +6.21%) — steady cash returns supportive, Financials (1W: +0.85% | 1M: +0.55%) — watch earnings. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -6.51% | 1M: +6.28%) and Communication (1W: -4.63% | 1M: -7.04%) — watch for downside follow-through.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch NVDA for stabilization on a weekly close to avoid deeper BELOW TREND momentum; AAPL needs follow-through above short-term resistance to arrest its CORRECTION. JPM and PNC breaking near-term highs would reinforce Financial leadership; continued weak weekly closes in MSFT/CRM would confirm Tech downside.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
MDT (+80): Medtronic FDA nod — MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed by price. LLY (+80): FDA dosing approval — LLY (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +18.07%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. AMAT (+55): AI/expansion narrative — AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed; SHOP (+70) shows bullish headlines but SHOP (1W: -10.75% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND — news diverging from price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
INTU (-45): negative headlines — INTU (1W: -13.64% | 1M: -24.90%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. ACN (-45): lower PT headlines — ACN (1W: -11.27% | 1M: -3.20%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. Monitor these names for continued weakness and talk-through risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. MDT, UNH and LLY are showing strength (ABOVE TREND) while MSFT, NVDA and several large-cap Techs are showing weakness (BELOW TREND/CORRECTION). Key risk: narrow leadership and major 1W/1M divergences in Tech with mixed news confirmations (SHOP and PFE headlines diverge from price) — watch for trend confirmation.
